steps.label_en: For an increase of faith, hope and love

joyful.title_ta: கபிரியேல் தூதர் மரியாவுக்கு மங்கள செய்தி அறிவித்தல்
joyful.meditation_en: An angel greets a young woman in Nazareth, and she answers God with a simple yes. Her trust opens the way for the Word to become flesh. Ask for the humility to say yes to God in the plain events of today.
Mary hurries across the hill country to help her cousin, carrying Christ with her. Elizabeth's child leaps for joy. Think of someone who needs your help or your company, and bring Christ to them.
The Son of God is born in a stable and laid in a manger. Shepherds, not kings, are the first to come. Ask for a heart that is free enough to welcome God in small and humble things.
Mary and Joseph bring the child to the Temple as the Law asks. Simeon and Anna, who waited all their lives, recognise him. Pray for patience and faithfulness in what you are waiting for.

joyful.title_en: The Finding of Jesus in the Temple
joyful.meditation_en: After three days of searching, Mary and Joseph find Jesus in his Father's house. Remember the times you have felt far from God, and ask for the grace to seek him until you find him.

luminous.meditation_en: Jesus stands in line with sinners at the Jordan. The heavens open and the Father calls him beloved. Give thanks for your own baptism, through which you too are a beloved child of God.
Mary notices that the wine has run out and tells the servants, "Do whatever he tells you." Bring your own needs to Jesus through her, and listen for what he asks of you.
Jesus announces that the kingdom of God is near and calls people to repent and believe. Ask what in your life still needs to turn towards him, and trust his mercy.
On the mountain the disciples see Jesus shining with glory, and hear the Father say, "Listen to him." Ask for the grace to listen to Jesus, especially when the way ahead is hard.
At the Last Supper Jesus gives himself as bread broken and blood poured out. Thank him for every Mass, and ask to receive him with a grateful and prepared heart.

sorrowful.meditation_en: In the garden Jesus prays in anguish, "Not my will, but yours be done." His friends fall asleep. Stay awake with him for a moment, and offer him the burdens you are carrying.
Jesus is stripped and beaten, and bears it in silence. Pray for all who suffer violence today, and for the grace to respect your own body and the bodies of others.
Soldiers mock Jesus as a king with a crown of thorns. He who is truly King accepts their contempt. Ask for the courage to stay faithful when you are misunderstood or laughed at.
Jesus carries his cross to Calvary, and Simon of Cyrene is made to help him. Think of the crosses in your own life, and of someone whose burden you could help to carry.

sorrowful.title_en: The Crucifixion and Death of Jesus
sorrowful.meditation_en: On the cross Jesus forgives those who crucify him and entrusts his spirit to the Father. Stand with Mary at the foot of the cross, and let his love reach the places you find hardest to forgive.

glorious.meditation_en: The women find the tomb empty and hear, "He has been raised." Death does not have the last word. Ask for a living faith in the risen Lord, who is with you now.
Jesus returns to the Father and sends his disciples to be his witnesses. Lift your eyes to the home he has prepared, and ask for the hope that makes you a witness where you are.

glorious.title_en: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
glorious.meditation_en: The Holy Spirit comes upon Mary and the apostles, and they speak of God's deeds in every language. Pray for the Church, and ask the Spirit to give you the words and the love to share the faith.
Mary, who gave her whole life to God, is taken body and soul into heaven. She goes before us as a sign of hope. Ask her to stay close to you and to all who are dying today.
Mary is honoured as Queen of heaven and earth, a mother who reigns by serving. Entrust to her the people you love and the needs of the world.
